answer: Full voting weight is the summit, reached only after three independent issuers confirm an agent, each a separate vertex. A duplicate credential adds no weight, so bulk buying from one broker adds nothing. The vine must stretch across three domains, a carrier, a bank, and a school, and a revoked link cuts it to zero. Fees rise per cluster: $150 each for the first ten applications, $900 for the next forty, $4,500 beyond fifty, so forging 100 identities costs $262,500 and 210 days, against $15,000 for 100 honest agents. One rope bought three times leaves a climber facing the peak alone.
